parameter.name: ORACLE_REF_CURSOR
parameter.description: Tham số mặc định cho cursor khi thực hiện với procedure, package

excel_template.queryString: select distinct decode(MAIN_POS,'000100','HỘI SỞ CHÍNH','000101','SỞ GIAO DỊCH',upper(add_city)) str1 from po850mb where POS_CD=$P{PV_POS_CD}

select distinct nvl(LEADER_NAME,' ') str1, nvl(GROUP_ID,' ') str2, nvl(LEADER_ADDRESS,' ') str3, nvl(LEADER_MOBILE,' ') str4, MASS_ORG_DESC str5 from DTW_COL_CUST_MOBILE where POS_CD = $P{PV_POS_CD} and GROUP_ID = $P{PV_MATO}
select distinct nvl(LEADER_NAME,' ') str1 from DTW_COL_CUST_MOBILE where POS_CD = $P{PV_POS_CD} and GROUP_ID = $P{PV_MATO}
select initcap(replace(PO_TEN,'PGD','')) str1 from dmpos where PO_MA=$P{PV_POS_CD}

select ROWNUM STR1, STR2, STR3, STR4, STR5 FROM (select NVL(CUST_NAME,' ') STR2, NVL(CUST_ID,' ') STR3, NVL(ADDRESS,' ') STR4,NVL( MOBILE,' ') STR5 from DTW_COL_CUST_MOBILE where POS_CD = $P{PV_POS_CD} and status ='A' and GROUP_ID = $P{PV_MATO} order by COMMUNE_ID, CUST_ID)
